svg.aria-label: On-Demand Calculations — LST & Sky View Factor
svg.title: On-Demand Calculations — LST & Sky View Factor
svg.text: On-Demand Calculations — LST & Sky View Factor
Actions menu → Calculate for this view: the current map view is computed in numpy and stored as one raster row
the view + a halo of one radius
one raster row per view: LandSurfaceTemperature (°C) / SkyViewFactor
a recalculation replaces the covered rows of the same scene / DSM (+ COG files)
no receiver: a post_save must never start an Earth Engine download
Grid = the view clipped to the NDVI layers' coverage. A scene with no water-vapour
source for its day fails before the download. The TPW source is kept in measurement_method.
Reads only the view plus the halo, so the horizon at the edge of the view is
still seen. One SkyViewFactor row per view; source = "DSM <id>: …".
Both are synchronous requests (LST ~10–60 s). Earth Engine only serves the inputs; every equation runs in numpy.
Same tools from the shell: manage.py calculate_lst --city Enschede · physicalEnv.svf.calculate_svf(bbox=…).
